author: GamingBolt
description:
The Wolf Among Us Remastered feels like a true labour of love. The improved character models, refreshed environments, remastered audio and technical fixes all help bring Telltale's classic adventure to a new generation, while things like noir mode, deleted scenes, interviews and art gallery make this a robust package for returning fans.

If you've never played The Wolf Among Us, this is the version to get. And if you've already spent time with Bigby and the residents of Fabletown, there is plenty within this remaster to make another visit worth your while.
title: The Wolf Among Us: Remastered Review - Bigby Wolf Is Back

author: GamingBolt
description:
Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown has been an expansion we simply can’t wait to dive into once it's on the shelves. That’s for a variety of reasons, many of which we’ve already covered quite extensively in our previous videos on the upcoming DLC to one of the year’s biggest open worlds.

However, a bunch of new details have stemmed from a podcast appearance by none other than Will Powers, who heads marketing for the game. There’s new stuff to dive into, and a lot of it makes us quite optimistic that the DLC is taking the experience in a very desirable direction. 

We’re happy to explain why we think so, and invite you on one last trip into the metaphorical unknown before the expansion reveals all to us.
title: Crimson Desert: Charting The Unknown - 10 New Details You NEED To Know

author: GamingBolt
description:
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake is a few weeks away, but can its changes make it better in ways that matter? We dove into everything that’s been revealed about the game so far, intent on answering that very question, and we can tell you that what we’ve found is interesting.

It points to an experience that’s ambitious, yes, but also quite measured in the way it tries to balance player agency against creative control in ways that play out quite interestingly in various important areas. We’ve put down some of our thoughts, as is our wont, and welcome you to join us on a quick jaunt to Hyrule and everything it contains.
title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake - Can A More Focused Adventure Be Its Biggest Strength?
